title: Stitching Machine Operator (Tailoring)
text: Operates sewing machines, stitches garments, alters clothes, uses tape, scissors, chalk. Suits people who stitch, tailor, embroider or repair clothes at home.

title: Dairy Farmer / Entrepreneur
text: Rearing cattle, milking, feed and fodder management, animal health basics, selling milk to cooperatives. Suits people who keep cows or buffaloes.

title: Organic Grower
text: Crop planning, composting, pest management without chemicals, irrigation, harvesting and marketing. Suits farmers and kitchen-garden growers.

title: Electrician - Domestic
text: Wiring, fitting switches and fans, repairing appliances, using testers and pliers. Suits people who repair electrical items.

title: Food Processing Assistant
text: Cooking in bulk, pickles, snacks, packaging, hygiene, selling at markets. Suits people who cook and sell food.

title: Retail Sales Associate
text: Selling goods, handling customers, cash and stock. Suits people who run or help in shops and stalls.
